subject: gk
question: The second edition of the Khelo India Winter Games 2021 was held in which of the following states/Union Territories?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu and Kashmir**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Khelo India National Winter Games 2021:-

 
 
• The second edition of 'Khelo India National Winter Games 2021' was inaugurated in Jammu and Kashmir's Baramulla district on 26 February 2021.
 
• The games were held in the ski resort of Gulmarg, which is located in the Baramulla district.
 
• The event was inaugurated virtually by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, and saw participation from over 1200 people, including 600 athletes from across 27 states and union territories.
 
• The games were held in a variety of winter sports disciplines, including skiing, snowboarding, ice hockey, figure skating, ice stock, and snowshoe racing.
 
• The host team, Jammu and Kashmir, won the maximum number of medals, with a tally of 34 medals, including 11 gold medals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** About Khelo India:

 
• ​Khelo India is a national sports development programme
 
• Launched by the government to revive the sports culture in India at the grass-root level.
 
• Youth Games at school and college levels in various summer Olympic sports and more are already being held at a large scale under Khelo India since 2018.
 
• Now, winter sports are also receiving support from Khelo India.
